name: Redlands
card: The Grand Junction area south of the Colorado River, near the Colorado National Monument.
near: It is part of Grand Junction, south of the river.
metaTitle: Redlands Websites and Local SEO | Nick Perry Digital
metaDescription: Websites and local SEO for businesses in the Redlands area of Grand Junction. Honest listing setup and posted prices.
body:
The Redlands is an area of Grand Junction south of the Colorado River, close to the Colorado National Monument. It is not a separate city. Residents still use the name when they search for a nearby service.

If your shop is in the Redlands, the site can say so. The Google listing should use your real Grand Junction address. A second listing labeled as if the Redlands were another town is a mistake.
businesses: Home services that work the south side of Grand Junction
extraQ: Should a Redlands business use a Grand Junction address?
extraA: Yes. Use the real street address. Mention the Redlands on the site so neighbors know you are close. Do not open a second Google listing just to chase the neighborhood name.
